title: ABS Document v0.1
description: Normative JSON Schema for Agent Behavior Specification v0.1 documents. A document that passes this schema is syntactically valid ABS v0.1. Semantic rules (variable resolution, ordering, target interpretation) are defined in SPECIFICATION.md and are not enforced by this schema.

description.description: Optional description of what this session covers.

abs_version.description: Version of the ABS spec this document targets. Optional in v0.1, RECOMMENDED, will be REQUIRED in v0.2.

behaviors.description: Ordered list of Behaviors and/or fragment includes. REQUIRED.

fragments.description: Named reusable lists of Behaviors. Referenced by include: entries in behaviors.

evaluations.description: Session-level (chain) evaluations operating over the whole trace.

include.description: Name of a fragment declared in the top-level fragments: map. The fragment's Behaviors are expanded in place before any other processing.

actor.description: Who performs this Behavior. Common values: user, assistant, tool, system, human, external.

action.description: What is performed. See VOCABULARY.md for the standard list.

target.description: Object or destination of the action. Meaning depends on the action category — see SPECIFICATION.md §4.

content.description: Payload of the Behavior: free text, structured data, or displayed information. Intentionally untyped in v0.1.

capture.description: Names runtime values for later reuse via {{variable}} syntax. Each key becomes a variable name. See VARIABLES.md.

with.description: Parameters passed on an outbound Action (typically calls). Partial match by default — the observed call must contain all these keys but may contain additional ones. For strict matching use with_only.

with_only.description: Parameters passed on an outbound Action. Strict match — the observed call must contain exactly these keys and no others. Mutually exclusive with with.

evaluations.description: Step-level evaluations for this Behavior only.

blocking.description: If true, failure of this evaluation marks downstream dependent evaluations as inconclusive rather than failed. See EVALUATIONS.md, 'Failure semantics'.

value.description: The observed content must equal this exactly.
The observed content must contain this substring (case-insensitive by default).

pattern.description: The observed content must match this regular expression.

schema.description: A JSON Schema to validate the observed content against.

target.description: Which tool should have been called.

with.description: Parameters that must be present in the call (partial match).

ordered.description: If multiple calls in a row, must they be in this order? Default true.

criteria.description: Natural-language rubric for the LLM judge.

id.description: Identifier for the custom evaluator implementation (e.g. my-org.sentiment-positive).

order.description: Selectors that must match Behaviors in the trace, in increasing position.

variable.description: Every resolved value of this variable in the trace must be equal.

selector.description: Identifies Behaviors in the trace. A field that's present must match exactly; a field that's omitted is a wildcard.
